content.thinking: The code compares raw string `s` with its reverse, without normalizing case or removing spaces. So "Madam" reversed is "madaM" which differs case-sensitively; "never odd or even" reversed has spaces in different positions. Need to ignore case and spaces. Give level 1 conceptual nudge.

input.text: Your check is comparing the exact characters in the input to their exact reverse. But the problem asks you to ignore two things before deciding whether the text is a palindrome: differences in capitalization, and any space characters. Think about normalizing the string first — making everything the same case and removing spaces — so the comparison is based only on the letters.
